description:
The farmOS Field Kit app is open on the Tasks screen showing 'Let's Get Started!'. Your task:
1. Tap the green '+' button at the bottom right to create a new log.
2. In the 'Edit Log' form on the GENERAL tab:
   a. Enter 'Applied fertilizer to north field' as the Name.
   b. Change the Log Type from 'Activity' to 'Input'.
   c. Change the time to 08:00 AM (set Hour to 08, Min to 00, select AM).
   d. In the Notes field, enter '10-10-10 fertilizer, 200 lbs per acre'.
   e. Toggle the 'Done' switch to OFF.
3. Switch to the MOVEMENT tab and verify you can see the map.
4. Switch back to the GENERAL tab.
5. Tap the back arrow to save and return to the Tasks list.
6. Verify the new Input log appears in the Tasks list with the correct name.
